# S63 — TUI: view, edit and add slice notes

## Why

them. Split from S18.

## Implement

Show item notes in the detail pane for any item (bare or promoted). `e` on a note edits it in
`$EDITOR`; saving empty removes it. A trailing "+ add a note" entry, also via `e`, adds one,
dated through `ops.add_note` like the CLI. Entry/EditRequest gain a note index; entries() and
panel() stay in sync (the add line's entry index is the last entry).

## Check

entries()/panel() include a note per note plus a trailing add entry, indices aligned;
apply_edit_result adds/edits/removes notes on a real repo; existing TUI tests updated for the
new trailing entry. Focused TUI tests, the unit suite, slicer check, git diff --check.
